scripts.deploy:functions:iam: gcloud run services add-iam-policy-binding listpublicfeed --project=keyc-studio --region=asia-northeast3 --member=allUsers --role=roles/run.invoker --quiet && gcloud run services add-iam-policy-binding recordplay --project=keyc-studio --region=asia-northeast3 --member=allUsers --role=roles/run.invoker --quiet && gcloud run services add-iam-policy-binding unsharework --project=keyc-studio --region=asia-northeast3 --member=allUsers --role=roles/run.invoker --quiet
scripts.deploy:functions:signer: SA=$(gcloud projects describe keyc-studio --format='value(projectNumber)')-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com && gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding "$SA" --member="serviceAccount:$SA" --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator --project=keyc-studio --quiet
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy && npm run deploy:cors && npm run deploy:functions:iam && npm run deploy:functions:signer
